sources.title: Mongolia Consular Department: visa-exempt passports schedule
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Mongolia, Consular Department
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Consular Department page identifies its Ministry of Foreign Affairs address and is linked by the Immigration Agency as its visa-exempt-countries authority. It separates all-passport/ordinary visitor exemptions from diplomatic, official and service agreements.

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia: eVisa-eligible countries
sources.officialityEvidence: This live list is published on immigration.gov.mn, identifies the Immigration Agency as the Government Implementing Agency, and expressly labels itself as the eVisa country list. It is used only as a positive nationality schedule, never as a residual rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of countries eligible for Mongolian E-Visa

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia: tourist visas at the international border
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Immigration Agency page is a named positive list of nationalities for tourist visas issued at an international border without a visa permit. It does not state an unlisted-nationality consequence.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Tourist visas can be issued at the international border without visa permit

sources.title: Law of Mongolia on the Legal Status of Foreign Nationals
sources.officialityEvidence: The current legal text is hosted by Mongolia's Immigration Agency. It provides the general visa, electronic-visa, border-issuance and treaty framework but does not map the scoped ordinary passports to a single route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Unless provided otherwise in the international treaties of Mongolia, foreign national visiting in Mongolia shall have a Mongolian visa.
